reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence medium). LesPAC documents an automatic listing-transfer (import) API available to advertisers on an active monthly plan; no search API.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://www.lespac.com/en/public/listing/import/technical-documentation): LesPAC documents an automatic listing-transfer (import) API available to advertisers on an active monthly plan; no search API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
